name: @caotang/import-yw7
description: The yWriter .yw7 project reader for the yWriter import (#291): one XML file (UTF-8 or UTF-16), parts from SectionStart chapters, scenes with point of view, day offsets, durations and declared cast, and codex entries from characters, places and items. Written from the file format only (the upstream app is GPL); no DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
